## Question

What exact research question does this PR answer?

## Claim classes

List each meaningful claim as PROVEN / OBSERVED / SUPPORTED / INFERRED / VENDOR_CLAIM / UNKNOWN / REJECTED.

## Evidence

What retained artifact, protocol, source inspection, or reproduction supports the result?

## Provenance

Identify all third-party material, revisions, licenses, and modifications.

## Negative results / caveats

What failed, remains unknown, or limits generality?

## Sign-off

Commits should include a DCO-style Signed-off-by trailer.
